pages.title: Serenity Yoga Studio – Classes & Wellness in Your Neighborhood
pages.html:
🧘Serenity Yoga

Welcome to Serenity Yoga Studio

Find your peace, strengthen your body, and calm your mind in our welcoming neighborhood studio.

Start Your Journey Today

Our Philosophy

At Serenity Yoga Studio, we believe that yoga is more than just exercise—it's a path to wellness that honors both body and mind. Founded in 2018, our studio has grown into a sanctuary for over 500 members seeking balance, strength, and inner peace.

Inclusive

Every body, every level, every journey is welcome here. Our classes are designed for beginners through advanced practitioners.

Authentic

We honor traditional yoga practices while creating a modern, supportive environment for your personal growth.

Community

Connect with like-minded individuals and build lasting friendships while deepening your practice.

Class Schedule

Join us for classes throughout the week. All classes are 60 minutes unless noted.

Time Monday–Friday Saturday Sunday
6:00 AM Sunrise Flow — —
9:00 AM Gentle Yoga Gentle Yoga Restorative (90 min)
12:00 PM Lunch Hour Power — —
5:30 PM Vinyasa Flow Vinyasa Flow Yin Yoga
7:00 PM Hatha Basics — —

New to yoga? Sunrise Flow and Gentle Yoga classes are perfect for beginners. Drop-in rates: $18 per class, or $99/month for unlimited classes.

Stories from Our Members

"I came to Serenity looking for stress relief, and I found a second home. The instructors are incredibly knowledgeable, and the community is so welcoming. I've been coming for two years now."

— Maria Chen, Portland, OR

"As someone who'd never done yoga before, I was nervous. But from my first Gentle Yoga class, I felt at ease. The instructors meet you where you are and celebrate your progress."

— James Mitchell, Portland, OR

"Serenity's vinyasa classes have transformed my fitness and mental clarity. Plus, the studio is only a 10-minute walk from my apartment—perfect for fitting wellness into my busy life."

— Sarah Thompson, Portland, OR

Ready to Begin?

Sign up for your free introductory class and discover why hundreds of neighbors choose Serenity as their yoga home.

Questions? Call us at (503) 555-0847 or visit us at 428 Maple Avenue, Portland, OR 97214

Serenity Yoga Studio
